description: Tier C — cross-service scenario coverage. Case ids are used verbatim by suites/workflows.sh.

commands.cmd: scenario: net+subnet, bootable volume from image, server boot with --network and --block-device; verify ACTIVE, address on the net, attachment from compute and volume views
scenario: boot a server, snapshot it with server image create, boot a second server from the new image; verify both ACTIVE
scenario: volume create, server add volume, verify attachment on volume show and server show, server remove volume, verify empty, delete
scenario: security group create, ssh rule add with port range, rule listed, server add/remove security group, rule remove, group delete (API state only — stub mode does not enforce dataplane)

scenario: external network + subnet, router with external gateway and internal interface, server on the internal net, floating ip create/associate/disassociate/release (API state only — router dataplane not exercised)
scenario: two projects with a user each and identically-named networks; each user's auth-scoped list shows only their own network; admin tenant_id list filter tracked as known failure
scenario: set tiny volume quota (gigabytes and volumes) on a dedicated project, verify exceeding creations fail with quota errors, restore, verify creation works again
